summary:
## Standing operator rules
- Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.
- Never modify files under ledgerly/customer_export/ without posting the proposed diff in #privacy-review and receiving approval from @mina.
- For “Kafka repartition offset migration,” run the provided nine steps in order, one at a time.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix Quebec QST tax calculation in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py`. Kafka migration and tracing work are paused; webhook work is complete but superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Kafka: `kafka-01:9092`, `orders.v1`→`orders.v2`, groups `orders-v1`→`orders-v2`, partitions 6→12. Staging Redis: `redis://cache-eu-3:6379`; `cache-eu-1` is superseded and must not receive writes. Canonical parser fields: `currency`, `status`; helper: `_add_billing_filters()`. Search rebuild now requires `Invoice.for_tenant(self.tenant_id)`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours caused stuck jobs to remain invisible for hours; do not retry.

## Recent work
Kafka steps 1–3 ran. Search rebuilds were optimized with shared embeddings, bulk vector upserts, and a missing tenant/document index migration; full suite passed (247 passed, 4 skipped), and the 10,000-document benchmark improved from 16.73s to 2.41s median. CSV UTF-8 regression fixes and tests passed.
